sample_anomalies.rule: Rebuild from actual trip facts; do not copy historical range.
Use verified WorkOut fact rows, not the historical label or sample expense date.

workflow_additions: Traffic and meals are separate reimbursement detail categories; each actual trip day has separate traffic and meal explanation entries.
Traffic equals preserved mileage times 1 yuan plus deduplicated actual tolls.
Meals apply to the current form creator only at 30 yuan per actual verified day.
Allocate each linked form across its actual trip days and reconcile relations, detailrels, details, costs, bank and header totals.
Validate current applicant/creator/payee and current applicable budget rather than adopting another operator or expired template settings.
Keep an attachment inventory for mileage workbook, fuel invoices, toll invoices and corroborating summaries; this read-only task performs no upload.
